settings.title: TossPayments Settings
settings.test_mode_hint: No real payments occur in test mode.
settings.test_client_key_hint: Found in Developer Center > API Keys
settings.redirect_success_url_hint: {shopBase} is filled in from the storefront address setting. You may also enter a full URL (https://...). {orderId} will be replaced with the actual order number.
settings.redirect_fail_url_hint: {shopBase} is filled in from the storefront address setting. You may also enter a full URL. Error details (error, message, orderId) are appended as query parameters.
settings.order_sheet_mode_hint: When ON, payment methods are chosen at checkout. When OFF, a single TossPayments integrated window (card) is used.
settings.enabled_methods_hint: Select the payment methods shown at checkout in order-sheet mode.
settings.vbank_valid_hours_hint: Hours available for deposit after issuing a virtual account. Max 2160 (90 days).
settings.vbank_cash_receipt_type_hint: Cash receipt type TossPayments auto-issues when a virtual account is created.
settings.use_escrow_hint: Applies to virtual account and bank transfer only.
settings.escrow_no_partial_cancel_notice: Escrow orders cannot be partially cancelled. Only full cancellation is available.
settings.escrow_shipping_info_notice: Register shipping information in the TossPayments merchant console.
settings.webhook_secret_verify_hint: Verifies the deposit webhook secret against the payment confirmation response to block forged requests.
settings.webhook_url_hint: Prefix this path with your store's full domain (https://your-domain) and register it as a DEPOSIT_CALLBACK event in the TossPayments Developer Center > Webhook menu.

payment_cancelled_message: Payment has been cancelled. Please try again or choose a different payment method.

errors.non_krw_method: This payment method is available for KRW payments only.
